# skill_research_semantics

Every research name says what kind of object it denotes — a point in time, an interval, a bar granularity, a forward horizon, a backward history, a validation segment, a search state or an HPO trial — and one concept holds one meaning across the modules: the rules here fix the meanings and how they relate, the register holds the names, the methodologies hold the values.

## Naming

- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-NAME-SAYS-WHAT-KIND-OF-OBJECT-IT-IS`
  - Description: A research name says, without opening a methodology, which kind of object it denotes: a point in time, an interval, a bar granularity, a forward horizon, a backward history, a validation segment, a search state or its evaluation, an HPO study or one of its trials.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: A point named as `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-POINT-IN-TIME-IS-MS-OR-UTC` asks, an interval a `<what>_window`, a bar granularity a timeframe, a forward duration a `<what>_horizon`, a backward history a lookback or the warm-up, a validation segment a fold, a point of the search space a `search_state` and its one scored computation a `state_evaluation`, an HPO point a trial of a study — each in the canonical term its row of `module_skills/skill_glossary.md` gives.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-POINT-IN-TIME-IS-MS-OR-UTC`
  - Description: A point in time is named as a point: an epoch millisecond ends in `_ms` and a UTC text in `_utc`, while `_ts` belongs to the contract's three event columns alone — `decision_ts`, `entry_ts`, `event_end_ts` — and to a name that qualifies one of them.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `timestamp_ms`, `warmup_end_ms`, `fold_start_ms`, `timeframe_open_ms`, `start_utc`, `last_observation_utc`; `y_decision_ts` for the `decision_ts` of Y; no `_ts` on another instant, and no point's name on a duration.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-TIMEFRAME-IS-A-BAR-GRANULARITY`
  - Description: A timeframe is the length one bar aggregates and nothing else — never a horizon, a window or a lookback — and where it plays a role its name says which: the decision timeframe, a feature's timeframe, the barrier's timeframe, the top timeframe.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `timeframe` for a token of the hierarchy, `decision_timeframe`, `feature_id(definition, timeframe)`, `LABEL_BARRIER_TRUE_RANGE_TIMEFRAME`, `trend_gate_timeframe()`, `SOURCE_CANDLE_TIMEFRAME`; a venue's own word for it, `interval`, at the venue's call alone.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-HORIZON-POINTS-FORWARD`
  - Description: A horizon is the forward duration from a reference event to the latest moment it may resolve, and its name says what it is the horizon of; a token of the timeframe grammar takes its meaning from the field that holds it, never from its spelling.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `label_horizon` for the token and `label_horizon_minutes` for its minutes, `HORIZON_TOKEN_MINUTES` the one table that turns a token into minutes; no horizon named as a timeframe, a window, a period or a lookback.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-LOOKBACK-POINTS-BACKWARD`
  - Description: A lookback is the history a computation reads backward from the bar it stands on, and it is never a warm-up or a horizon.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `lookback_bars` and an indicator's `LOOKBACK` parameter word; the bars it spans a lookback window.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-THE-WARM-UP-PRECEDES-THE-FIRST-DECISION`
  - Description: The warm-up is the history the widest definition needs before the first decision it allows: it excludes decisions, and it is never a training window and never a fold.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `WARMUP_TOP_TIMEFRAME_BARS`, `warmup_end_ms`, `warmup_excluded_decision_count`; F1 holding the warm-up inside it, never a warm-up drawn beside the folds.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-WINDOW-IS-AN-INTERVAL`
  - Description: A window is one continuous interval `[start, end)` named for what it bounds; it is never a population of rows, a role of a model or a duration token, and a block that holds a window beside other values is not itself a window.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `research_window` with `start_utc` and `end_utc` alone, the data window from `DATA_WINDOW_START_UTC`, a kline request window, a lookback window; the rows inside an OOS block `oos_block_rows`, never a `_window`.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-FOLD-IS-A-NAMED-SEGMENT-OF-THE-RESEARCH-WINDOW`
  - Description: A fold is a named chronological segment of the research window with a role in the validation geometry, so a fold is a window; its OOS block is the part it is scored on — here the whole fold — and the final holdout is the fold that never selects.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `fold_id`, `VALIDATION_FOLD_IDS`, `FINAL_HOLDOUT_FOLD_ID`, a fold's bounds `fold_start_ms` and `fold_end_ms` from `fold_bounds()`, `oos_fold_id` for the fold a prediction belongs to; no split, period, chunk or test for a fold.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-SCOPE-IS-A-SET-NEVER-A-DURATION`
  - Description: A scope says what belongs to a set, never how long anything lasts, and a research name that carries the word qualifies it by what the set admits.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `experiment_scope`, `selection_scope`, `evaluation_scope`, `feature_scope`, `asset_scope`; a set of folds `VALIDATION_FOLD_IDS` and an interval a window, never a scope.
  - Exception: The rule table's `scope` column — the files a rule governs — and the lexical scope of a programming language.
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-AN-EXPERIMENT-IS-FROZEN-AND-A-RUN-EXECUTES-IT`
  - Description: An experiment is the frozen context a comparison is made in, and a run is one execution of it, resumable from what its files say; a calibration search is an experiment of its own, and a streak of minutes is never a run.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: The chain's CONFIGURABLES records at a commit and a serpentine search's `inputs` as experiments; `run_id` and the turns of one search as runs; a calibration search; `longest_flat_streak_minutes`; no calibration run.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-SEARCH-STATE-HAS-ONE-IDENTITY`
  - Description: A search state is one complete point of the serpentine search's space with one identity, and its one scored computation is a state evaluation; a bare `state` never names it, and Optuna's trial state stops at the call that reads it.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `search_state`, `search_state_key(theta())`, `state_evaluation`, `state_evaluation_index`, `state_evaluation_count`, `<TICKER>_serpentine_search_state_evaluations.jsonl`; the search's progress, `<TICKER>_serpentine_search.json`, which is not a search state; `hpo_trial_outcome` from `trial.state`.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-TRIAL-IS-ONE-HPO-STUDY-POINT`
  - Description: A study is one HPO over one defined space, and a trial is exclusively one point of parameters a study drew; a line of the serpentine search's ledger is never a trial.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `study_index`, `hpo_trial_index`, `hpo_trial_count`, `hpo_trial_outcome`, the families `hpo_trials` and `score_trials`; no trial, trial index or trial count for a search state or its evaluation.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-N-COUNTS-SELECTION-HYPOTHESES`
  - Description: The count a selection's noise margin is taken at is the selection hypothesis count, which the methodology gives as one equation over the classes of evaluation it sums; it is never a trial count.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `selection_hypothesis_count` and `selection_hypothesis_count_by_search_axis`, counted at a round boundary and copied by every reader; the equation in `module_features/skills/methodology_features.md` § The serpentine search.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-SEARCH-AXIS-HOLDS-SEARCH-FAMILIES`
  - Description: A search axis is the part of a search state the search moves, a search family one generator of one kind of neighbour along it, and a round one pass through the frozen `ROUND_SCHEDULE`; a coordinate is one named component of the barrier geometry, and a round of boosting is a boosting round.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `search_axis` = `barrier` / `feature_set` / `hpo`, a profile's `search_axes`, `search_family` = `trade` / `label` / `forward` / `backward` / `study`, `round`, `BARRIER_COORDINATE_NAMES`, `num_boost_round` shown as boosting rounds; no loop and no iteration for any of them.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-PROPOSAL-IS-NOT-THE-CHAMPION-AND-A-PROMOTION-IS-NOT-A-WRITE`
  - Description: The beam is the ordered set of search states the ranking keeps, a proposal the one search state admitted to a promotion, and a promotion the one act that makes it the active search state; the champion is no proposal by being the champion, and writing a result promotes nothing.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: `beam` and its champion `beam[0]`; `proposals` as the serpentine search's rule admits them; `promote.py` writing the whole search state in one act, then the chain; no proposal read off the beam and no promotion by a stage writing its own artifact.
  - Exception: none

## Conformities

- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-ONE-CONCEPT-HAS-ONE-DEFINITION`
  - Description: One concept is defined once: this Skill states its meaning and how it relates to the others, the register its canonical name and surface forms, a methodology the values and derivations of this method, and code uses the name.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: A rule of meaning here, a row of `module_skills/skill_glossary.md`, a value in `methodology_features.md` or `methodology_ml.md` citing the rule, a name in code; no second definition in a README, a docstring or a comment.
  - Exception: none

## Methodology

- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-COMPARABLE-STATES-SHARE-ONE-EVALUATION-POPULATION`
  - Description: Search states compete only on one evaluation population: where a label horizon is a coordinate of an experiment, every search state is scored on the decisions whose entry leaves room for the experiment's maximum label horizon before the fold's end; a population that follows each search state's own horizon makes that horizon part of the experiment, never a coordinate of it.
  - Scope: `module_ml/*.py`, `module_features/sub_module_serpentine_search/**/*.py`
  - Expected: `entry_ts + maximum_label_horizon <= fold_end` for every search state of the experiment and for the chain that certifies one, `maximum_label_horizon` the longest label horizon the experiment's frozen grid admits; the label and the trade's exit still walked with the search state's own `label_horizon`.
  - Exception: none
- `RESEARCH-SEMANTICS-A-QUIET-ROUND-IS-NOT-CONVERGENCE`
  - Description: A round that leaves the beam where it was is a quiet round and nothing more: a search has converged only when a quiet round proves a fixed point — every search family it runs draws its neighbourhood deterministically from the beam, so another round would ask and be answered the same — and a search that spends its round budget without that proof has stopped by its budget; a proof in the budget's last round is convergence.
  - Scope: `module_features/sub_module_serpentine_search/**/*.py`, `module_features/status.py`, `module_features/sub_module_terminal/*.py`, `module_monitoring/features.js`
  - Expected: `beam_changed` for what a round did to the beam; `search_outcome` `converged` for a proven fixed point, `stopped_by_budget` for a spent budget without one, `null` for neither; a search family whose neighbourhood depends on the round — a study seeded anew each round — proving no fixed point, so a search that runs one ends by its budget; the proof tested before the budget.
  - Exception: none
